name: GTV Engineering Limited
about: GTV Engineering Limited engages in heavy and large fabrication, large machining activities in India. It operates through Hi-Tech Fabrication Engineering, Flour Division, and Agro Product Trading segments. The company offers turbines, stay rings, spiral casings, draft tube liners and cones, discharge elbows, radial gates, inner casings, exhaust hoods, pedestal assemblies, pressure vessels for steam turbine parts, head covers, bottom rings, butterfly valve assemblies, pit liners, MIV pipes, lower brackets, upper brackets, base frames for turbo and hydro generators, diffusers, pump storage turbine components, distributor pipes, penstocks, gear frame assemblies, center drive assemblies, and stator frames; fans, aluminum bus ducts and conductors, columns, coal bunkers and silos, casing panels, girders, boiler, stacks, and chimneys, air pre-heaters, fan casings, and structure components; and bucket wheel stacker reclaimers, wagon tipplers, ball mills, main bearing assemblies, HRP frames, transfer cars, HR thickeners, coal bins, kiln shells, kiln hoods, center tubes, deep cone washers, pelletizing disc components, pulverizer mills, coal mill parts, air guide assemblies, mill support assemblies, and bridge reclaimers. It also provides casings, stove shells, gas coolers, and tundish cars; VRM mills, gearbox plates, anchor plates, motor slide rails, roller supports, mill housing components, classifier components, louvers, grit cones, outlet ducts, pressure frames, separating wheel cages, grinding bowl assemblies, gypsum dryers, kiln hoods, girth gears, shells, and bucket wheel stacker reclaimers; under frames and bogie frames, and heavy structures; and plates, grit cones, louvers, mill liners, hoppers, chutes, fan blades, and separators. In addition, the company engages in the execution of several infrastructural projects. The company was formerly known as Gwalior Tanks & Vessels Ltd. GTV Engineering Limited was founded in 1978 and is based in Bhopal, India.
